Bihar sanitation workers end 8-day strike after government talks

Sanitation workers in Bihar have ended an eight-day strike following successful negotiations with the government. The strike, which involved approximately 1500 contract sanitation workers in Darbhanga Municipal Corporation, concluded on Tuesday. Workers celebrated the end of the strike with dancing and distributing sweets.
